Pass a lockfile's contents (package-lock.json, bun.lock, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, requirements.txt, poetry.lock, uv.lock, Pipfile.lock, Cargo.lock, go.sum, Gemfile.lock, composer.lock, mix.lock, packages.lock.json, gradle.lockfile, .github/wo

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_feed, check_stack · Private data: get_vulnerability, check_stack · Public sink: search, list_feed, check_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_feed, check_stack · Private data: get_vulnerability, check_stack · Public sink: search, list_feed, check_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
